items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel
items.claim: Aaron and his sons are commanded to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel
items.object: holy things of the children of Israel

items.quote: and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me
items.claim: Aaron and his sons are commanded not to profane the holy name in things they make sacred
